# testdata/

Cross-implementation test vectors used by the Go test suite to assert
byte-for-byte parity with the Python `seccure` reference.

## Contents

| File           | Source                              | Purpose                                                                |
|----------------|-------------------------------------|------------------------------------------------------------------------|
| `vectors.json` | Regenerated by `scripts/gen_vectors.py` from `py-seccure` | Pubkey / signature / DH / ECIES vectors for every (curve, passphrase) tuple |

## Regenerating

```sh
python -m venv .venv
. .venv/bin/activate
pip install seccure
python ../scripts/gen_vectors.py > vectors.json
```

CI runs this on every push so any upstream drift in `py-seccure` is caught
immediately.

## Adding a vector

Append the input to the deterministic grid in `scripts/gen_vectors.py`, then
regenerate. Don't hand-edit `vectors.json`.
